random.seed(5)
best=(0,None,None)
for trial in range(2000):
 npaths=random.randint(1,200)
 lens=[];rem=40000
 for i in range(npaths):
  L=random.randint(2,min(64,rem-(npaths-i-1)*2))
  lens.append(L);rem-=L
 agg={}
 for L in lens:
  verts=random.sample(range(1,400),L)
  p=tuple(verts);agg[p]=1
 rounds,cp,core=s.peel(agg)
 r=max(rounds.values(),default=0)
 if r>best[0]:
  best=(r,lens,(rounds,cp,core));print('new best rounds',r,'npaths',npaths,'sumlen',sum(lens),'removed',len(rounds),'core',len(core),'cp',len(cp),flush=True)
print('final',best[0])
